The AI Impact Matrix

Every PMM activity falls somewhere on the spectrum from "fully automatable" to "irreducibly human." This lab classifies your actual work and creates a transformation plan:

80%+ AI Production Tasks
50-79% AI Augmented Tasks
<30% AI Human-Essential

You'll get:

  • Activity Classification — Each task sorted into the right tier
  • Time Recovery — Hours/week you could reclaim through automation
  • Quick Wins — 3 things to automate THIS WEEK
  • Tool Recommendations — Specific tools for your top opportunities
  • 30-Day Pilot Plan — Your first AI workflow to implement
